Undo the last change (default), one journal entry, or every change of a session,
newest first. Inverses run without asking again; changes without an inverse
are reported and skipped. Needs `adbuddy serve` running.

Usage:
  adbuddy undo [last|session|<id>] [flags]

Examples:
  adbuddy undo
  adbuddy undo j_01J9Z…
  adbuddy undo session
  adbuddy undo session --session s_01J9Y…

Flags:
  -h, --help                   help for undo
      --session undo session   session for undo session (default: the current one)

Global Flags:
      --json   print machine-readable JSON on stdout
